meta.title: Systemic view, Humanist view, Transformation — Cepa Sur

hero.kicker: We propose a system of governance that creates value in the relationship between family, company and ownership
hero.purpose: Advise those who decide, so that family and wealth endure.
hero.lead: Family and corporate governance, with a systemic view: to articulate a shared purpose and to sustain it in company and ownership decisions.

familyGov.title: Family Governance
familyGov.statement: We propose a tailored design and accompany the implementation of the governance system, seeking the balance that creates value between family and company. We care for succession and for relationships in generational transfers, so that wealth and the enterprise endure: with clear rules, discussed with respect and upheld over time.

points.title: Family protocol
points.text: Agreements on ownership, family employment, dividends, and the resolution of conflict.

points.title: Succession
points.text: Preparing the next generation and the transfer of roles with explicit timelines and criteria.

points.title: Family and wealth
points.text: Family governing bodies that speak with the board and protect a shared purpose.

corpGov.title: Corporate Governance
corpGov.statement: We make the corporate purpose explicit and propose governance systems based on sound management practice and on what is distinctive to each organization. We align corporate strategy, transformation processes and the resolution of conflict at the different levels of governance, so that the board works, decisions are recorded, and the company endures without depending on a single person.

points.title: Boards
points.text: Composition, working methods, evaluation, and the relationship with management and shareholders.

points.title: Controls and transparency
points.text: Policies, information for governance, and practices that sustain internal trust.

points.title: Institutional continuity
points.text: Structures that allow growth, partnership, or managing succession without improvising governance.

company.title: Our view
company.statement: We are a multidisciplinary team that combines engineering with the humanities. We bring passion, rigour and creativity through a systemic approach that allows us to facilitate agreements at different levels and to support the formation and working of the Family Council, the Board and senior management.
company.body: We operate with small teams, a clear mandate, and complete discretion. We are not a mass-market firm: we accept few engagements in order to accompany them in depth. Our work takes place off the public stage — in boardrooms, family councils, and conversations that require reserve.

values.title: Discretion
values.text: Nothing entrusted to us circulates beyond the mandate.

values.title: Tailored
values.text: Each engagement is designed for that family and that company, not taken from a catalogue.

values.title: Rigour
values.text: Written agreements, realistic timelines, and a direct relationship with those who decide.

team.title: Team
team.lead: A small core of partners and advisers, experienced in corporate governance, business families, and boards.
team.note: Final profiles will be published with each member’s authorization.
